title: Skills + Scripts + Hooks
brief: Expose handbook intelligence through MCP actions, slash-command skills (/handbook-lookup, /handbook-ingest, /handbook-coverage, /handbook-compare), enforcement hooks (handbookLimitGuard, handbookFreshnessCheck, handbookCoverageGate), and maintenance scripts (coverage audit, freshness check, extraction validation).

units.title: Create handbook dispatcher with MCP actions: handbook_lookup (query by machine + section), handbook_ingest (trigger acquisition pipeline), handbook_coverage (fleet coverage report), handbook_compare (side-by-side machine capability comparison)
Create slash-command skills: /handbook-lookup, /handbook-ingest, /handbook-coverage, /handbook-compare with proper frontmatter, examples, and output formatting

Create enforcement hooks: handbookLimitGuard (block programs exceeding documented limits), handbookFreshnessCheck (warn on stale handbook data), handbookCoverageGate (warn on operations for machines without handbooks)

Create maintenance scripts: handbook-coverage-audit.ts (report ingestion status for all 910 machines), handbook-freshness-check.ts (flag stale data), handbook-extraction-validate.ts (validate extraction quality)

exit_conditions: All 4 handbook MCP actions registered in dispatcher and callable through MCP protocol
All 4 slash-command skills functional with correct output formatting
handbookLimitGuard hook blocks a test program that exceeds documented spindle speed
Coverage audit script correctly reports ingestion status across the machine fleet
